raw_segments.text: Where?" cried Grace. The three gentlemen retreated simultaneously. Mr. Rochester flung
me behind him. The lunatic sprang and grappled his throat viciously and laid her teeth to
his cheek. They struggled. She was a big woman in stature almost equaling her husband and
corpulent besides. She showed virile force in the contest. More than once she almost
throttled him, athletic as he was. He could have settled her with a well-planted blow,
but he would not strike. He would only wrestle.
At last he mastered her arms. Grace Poole gave him a cord and he pinioned them behind her. With
more rope, which was at hand, he bound her to a chair. The operation was performed amidst
the fiercest yells and the most convulsive plunges. Mr. Rochester then turned to the
spectators. He looked at them with a smile both acrid and desolate.
